_schema.description: Candidate profiles, keyed by candidate id ('<district or region id>/<slug of Given Surname>', App.candidateId: the seat the person is contesting). Researched by hand from public sources and written in our own words: facts only, no commentary, nothing guessed. Every fact cites one or more entries in its profile's sources list by number. Anything a source states but we couldn't confirm carries unverified: true and a note. Rules: CLAUDE.md, 'Candidate profiles'.

fields.name: The candidate's name as the tracker lists it
fields.summary: {text, src}: 2-4 sentences in our own words; never text copied from a source
fields.born: {year, src, unverified?, note?} or null: year of birth only, and only if published (e.g. Wikipedia, Parliament of Victoria)
fields.lives: {place, src, unverified?, note?} or null: suburb or town only, and only if the candidate has stated it publicly
fields.occupation: {text, src, unverified?, note?} or null: current or most recent occupation outside politics, or 'Member of Parliament'
fields.prior_roles: [{role, kind (mp | minister | shadow | councillor | mayor | staffer | union | business | party | public-service | community | other), organisation?, from (year), to (year, or null if current), ended (optional true: the role has ended but no source gives the year; to stays null), src, unverified?, note?}]
fields.previous_candidacies: [{election (e.g. '2022 Victorian state'), seat, party (code), result (Won | Lost | Retained | Withdrew | Unknown), src, unverified?, note?}]
fields.faction: {name, src, unverified?, note?} or null: only if reported by a mainstream news outlet or Wikipedia, citing that source
fields.priorities: [{text, quoted (true: the candidate's own words, under 15 words; false: our paraphrase), src}]: up to 5
fields.links: {website, party_page, abc, wikipedia, parliament, facebook, instagram, x, linkedin}: official pages and the candidate's own public accounts only; omit any that don't exist
fields.contact: {email: {value, kind (campaign | electorate office | party), src}, phone: {value, kind (party office | electorate office | campaign), src}}: published office or campaign contacts only; never personal numbers or addresses
fields.sources: [{id (number), url, title, accessed (YYYY-MM-DD)}]: every page a fact comes from
fields.profile_updated: YYYY-MM-DD when the profile was last researched
